sasha: Quick run — slicewise attention sweep across H100 / A100 / L40s. Seq sweep 128→16384, batch sweep 1/4/8/32. Dropping raw highlights here and a short note.

sasha: TL;DR: flashav2 fastest at mid seq (256-1024) on H100. fused-tiling best at short seq b<=8 on A100. paged-attn wins at very long seq (>=8k) on L40s due to efficient KV paging. HOWEVER: kernel-selector picked fused for 4096 on H100 which caused a measurable regression.

maria: can you paste the exact command/flags used so I can repro locally?

sasha: cmd: `./bench/attn_sweep.py --gpus H100,A100,L40s --seqs 128,256,512,1024,2048,4096,8192,16384 --bs 1,4,8,32 --variants flashav2,fused-tiling,paged` env: `KERNEL_STRATEGY=auto; PERF_LOG=1`

perf-bot: bench run 3490009876 completed. short summary: H100/flashav2/L=512/bs=8: 0.74 ms/token; H100/fused/L=4096/bs=8: 1.28 ms/token; A100/fused/L=256/bs=8: 1.02 ms/token; L40s/paged/L=16384/bs=1: 9.1 ms/token. Observed KV cache occupancy spike at L>=2048 with bs>=8 causing transient thrash.

aj: that matches my local repro. The selector rule currently says 'seq < 8192 -> fused' (legacy) — which explains why fused was chosen for 4096 on H100. Perf profile shows flashav2 faster up to 2048 on H100, so selector is stale.

liam: note — last week's selector patch bumped `memory_safety_margin` to avoid OOMs; it biases selection towards fused on some GPUs. Could be a side-effect, not intentional.

maria: do we have nvprof / nsys traces or flamegraphs for the differing kernels?

sasha: attaching short nvprof snippets (pasted):
```text
H100 flashav2 L=1024 bs=8: SM% 72, warp_serialize 1.2, achieved_occupancy 0.78
H100 fused   L=1024 bs=8: SM% 61, kernel-launchs+memcpy overhead ~12% of wall
```
These show fused has more kernel-launch overhead and lower SM util on H100 for this shape.

aj: so fused's launch overhead penalizes per-token throughput on H100 at mid seq. Selector should prefer flashav2 for seq <= 2048 on H100 when bs>=4.

liam: quick mitigation: update selector table entry for h100 -> prefer `flashav2` when seq <= 2048 && bs >= 4. Add canary rollout and a regression test that checks `selected_kernel` for the (h100,1024,8) shape.

maria: i'll file the ticket and attach perf artifacts. can someone add the exact repro command to the ticket?

sasha: filed ENG-RUNTIME-7832 and attached logs + traces. link: https://redwood/issue/ENG-RUNTIME-7832 :eyes: Repro command I used: `KERNEL_STRATEGY=manual:flashav2 ./bench/attn_sweep.py --gpu H100 --seqs 512,1024,2048 --bs 4,8`

perf-bot: queued canary rollout for selector patch to canary pool. monitoring SLOs for 2h. :rocket:

maria: ack, running the repro now and will paste numbers.

maria: run complete: flashav2 L=1024 bs=8 -> 0.76 ms/token ; fused L=1024 bs=8 -> 1.12 ms/token. confirmed flashav2 win on H100.

aj: great. propose landing selector change but gate the `memory_safety_margin` bump behind telemetry so we don't regress for other workloads.

liam: agreed. i'll draft PR: selector table tweak + unit tests + a telemetry knob for memory margin.

sasha: thanks all — after PR lands let's run the full seqmix sweep again and verify no regressions on A100 / L40s. :thumbsup:
